name: TeamMember
description: Core entity representing team members with their personal information, role assignments, department affiliations, and employment details

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the team member

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Team member's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Team member's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Team member's work email address

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Team member's contact phone number

fields.name: role
fields.description: Job role or position title

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Reference to the department the team member belongs to

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the team member's direct manager

fields.name: skills
fields.description: List of skills and competencies

fields.name: hireDate
fields.description: Date when the team member was hired

fields.name: status
fields.description: Employment status (active, inactive, on-leave)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the record was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated

relationships.description: Team member belongs to a department
Team member reports to a manager (self-referential)

email.message: Must be a valid email address

status.message: Status must be one of: active, inactive, on-leave

name: Department
description: Represents organizational departments with department heads and member associations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the department

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the department

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the department's purpose and responsibilities

fields.name: departmentHeadId
fields.description: Reference to the TeamMember who leads this department

fields.name: budget
fields.description: Annual budget allocated to the department

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the department was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the department was last updated

relationships.description: Department head relationship
Team members belonging to this department

constraints.uniqueDepartmentName: Department name must be unique across the organization
constraints.validBudget: Budget must be a positive number if specified

name: Attachment
description: Stores file attachments for tasks, projects, and performance reviews

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the attachment

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity this attachment belongs to (task, project, performanceReview)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the parent entity (task, project, or performance review)

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: fileType
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., application/pdf, image/png)

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: Storage path or URL where the file is stored

fields.name: uploadedBy
fields.description: ID of the team member who uploaded the file

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was uploaded

relationships.description: Team member who uploaded the attachment

indexes.description: Index for efficiently querying attachments by parent entity
Index for querying attachments by uploader

entityType.description: Restrict entity type to valid values

name: Project
description: Represents projects with timelines, status tracking, milestones, and team assignments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the project

fields.name: name
fields.description: Project name or title

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of project scope and objectives

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Reference to the owning department

fields.name: projectManagerId
fields.description: Reference to the team member managing the project

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Project start date

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: Project target completion date

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current project status (planning, active, on-hold, completed, cancelled)

relationships.description: Project belongs to a department
Project is managed by a team member
Project can have multiple attachments

name: LeaveRequest
description: Tracks employee leave and time-off requests with approval workflows and date ranges

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave request

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee requesting leave

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: Type of leave (vacation, sick, personal, etc.)

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: totalDays
fields.description: Total number of leave days requested

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reason or description for the leave request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the request (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)

relationships.description: Employee who submitted the leave request

endDate.validation: Must be greater than or equal to startDate

name: PerformanceReview
description: Captures performance reviews with ratings, comments, goals, and review cycles for team members

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the performance review

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the team member being reviewed

fields.name: reviewerId
fields.description: Reference to the team member conducting the review

fields.name: reviewPeriodStart
fields.description: Start date of the review period

fields.name: reviewPeriodEnd
fields.description: End date of the review period

fields.name: overallRating
fields.description: Overall performance rating (1-5 scale)

fields.name: reviewerComments
fields.description: Detailed comments and feedback from the reviewer

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the review (draft, submitted, completed)

relationships.name: employee
relationships.description: The team member being reviewed

relationships.name: reviewer
relationships.description: The team member conducting the review

name: Notification
description: Stores system notifications for task assignments, status updates, approvals, and system events

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: recipientId
fields.description: ID of the team member receiving the notification

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (task_assignment, status_update, approval_request, leave_approved, performance_review)

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short title or subject of the notification

fields.name: message
fields.description: Detailed notification message content

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of related entity (task, leave_request, performance_review, project)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the related entity that triggered the notification

fields.name: isRead
fields.description: Whether the notification has been read by the recipient

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was created

relationships.description: Notification belongs to a team member recipient

indexes.name: idx_recipient_read
indexes.description: Optimize queries for unread notifications by recipient

indexes.name: idx_entity
indexes.description: Optimize queries for notifications related to specific entities

name: Milestone
description: Represents key project milestones with dates and completion status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the milestone

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Reference to the associated project

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the milestone

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the milestone objectives

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Target completion date for the milestone

fields.name: completedDate
fields.description: Actual date when the milestone was completed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the milestone (pending, in-progress, completed, delayed)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the milestone was created

relationships.description: Each milestone belongs to one project

name: LeaveBalance
description: Maintains leave balance information for each employee by leave type

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave balance record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee (TeamMember)

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: Type of leave (Annual, Sick, Personal, etc.)

fields.name: totalDays
fields.description: Total allocated leave days for the year

fields.name: usedDays
fields.description: Number of leave days used

fields.name: remainingDays
fields.description: Number of leave days remaining

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year for which the leave balance applies

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last update timestamp

relationships.description: Each leave balance belongs to one employee

indexes.description: Ensure one balance record per employee, leave type, and year
Quick lookup of all leave balances for an employee in a year

name: Task
description: Represents individual tasks and assignments with priorities, status tracking, and due dates linked to projects

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title or name of the task

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the task requirements and objectives

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Reference to the project this task belongs to

fields.name: assigneeId
fields.description: Reference to the team member assigned to complete this task

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Task priority level (low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the task (todo, in_progress, review, completed, blocked)

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Target completion date for the task

relationships.description: Task belongs to a project
Task is assigned to a team member
Task can have multiple attachments

name: TimeLog
description: Records time entries for tasks to track actual hours worked and project time allocation

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the time log entry

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the team member who logged the time

fields.name: taskId
fields.description: Reference to the task for which time was logged

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date when the work was performed

fields.name: hoursWorked
fields.description: Number of hours spent on the task

fields.name: description
fields.description: Brief description of work performed during this time entry

fields.name: billable
fields.description: Indicates whether this time entry is billable to client

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the time log entry was created

relationships.description: Time log belongs to a team member
Time log is associated with a specific task

indexes.description: Optimize queries for employee time entries by date
Optimize queries for task time tracking

constraints.hoursWorked: Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 24

name: Comment
description: Stores comments and discussions on tasks and projects for team collaboration

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Reference to the team member who created the comment

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity being commented on (Task, Project, PerformanceReview, etc.)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the entity being commented on

fields.name: content
fields.description: The actual comment text content

fields.name: parentCommentId
fields.description: Reference to parent comment for threaded discussions

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated

relationships.description: Comment belongs to a team member author
Self-referential relationship for threaded comments

indexes.description: Composite index for efficiently querying comments by entity
Index for querying comments by author

constraints.entityType: Must be one of: Task, Project, PerformanceReview, LeaveRequest, Milestone
